title: M137 · Team Companion first patch, R1 (stop rule: items 1, 5, 6 shipped)
summary: The round hit the token cap on a swap-bound host, so the stop rule applied. Shipped on mission/M137-team-companion-first-patch: (1) bug reports, wishes and votes are now exported on every change (debounced, ≤1/s, atomic) to bug-reports.md and a new feedback.jsonl; the markdown can no longer be forged by report text, and reporter_is_admin comes from the server's admin rule; CLAUDE.md now has the tiered triage rule. (5) Password change on /profile ends your other sessions; admins mint a one-time 15-minute reset code on /admin/resets (or `reset-password <email>` with the app stopped), redeemed on /auth/reset; the login page says who to ask. (6) The access log drops the Referer and shows share tokens and invite codes as REDACTED (checked with a real Caddy 2.11.7); the app's slow-request log redacts /s/ paths too. Also written: the atelier critique with 10 recipe cards for the UI items and an identity proposal (three directions, proposal only). Not done, moved to R2: invite Copy (2), phone Match Day add action (3), autosave failure visibility (4), the 16+/terms checkbox (7), page titles and return-to-page (8). Gates: fmt, design lint and 386 lib tests pass; the integration tests and e2e could not run on brain (the compile stalled swap-bound twice) and run in CI on push. No screenshots: the server never finished starting on the overloaded host, so this card has no frame strips.

questions.text: Land mission/M137-team-companion-first-patch (items 1, 5, 6) once CI's integration and e2e jobs are green and VERIFY-R1 says PASS?

chips.label: Yes, merge
chips.consequence: The overseer lands it after CI and the verifier pass. Deploy stays a separate step (RUNBOOK §4, including --force-recreate caddy for the log filter).

chips.label: Not yet
chips.consequence: The branch stays open, and R2 builds the UI items on top of it before anything lands.

questions.recommend: Yes, merge — the reset path and the export are what the beta is missing most, and they don't depend on the UI items.

questions.text: Identity (react, don't pick): when an invited player opens a link from Discord on their phone, should the first screen feel like (A) a surveyor's field sheet, tightened and given its own role marks, (B) an analyst's table as dense as the sites they already use, or (C) a printed team sheet that stays dark in the app and turns to paper when shared? Full proposal with references: identity-proposal.md. Freeform welcome.

chips.label: A, role marks first
chips.consequence: R2+ draws the five role marks in /design first. Cheapest option; nothing else moves.

chips.label: A + C on share page
chips.consequence: A for the app, and a paper token set scoped to /s/{token} and print. B is skipped.

chips.label: B on stats/lists only
chips.consequence: A Dense density for /stats and list pages only; the rest stays as it is.

questions.recommend: A + C on share page — the shared page is what other teams see first, and A costs little. A fourth reaction is also legitimate: 'none, spend the effort on features'.

questions.text: Item 7 wording: the register checkbox will read “I am 16 or older and accept the [Terms] and have read the [Privacy page]” (English, stored as terms_accepted_at). Is that wording OK, or does your adviser change it?

chips.label: Use it
chips.consequence: R2 ships the checkbox with this text, with a TODO(legal-wording) marker until the adviser confirms.

chips.label: Wait for adviser
chips.consequence: R2 builds the checkbox but keeps it unshipped until you paste the final text.

questions.recommend: Use it — it states the age floor that the privacy page already assumes. The adviser can still change the words later without a code change.

questions.text: Item 2: the closed-beta and Impressum pages say a leader “or coach” can invite, but only leaders can. Should coaches get invite rights, or should the copy stop saying they can?

chips.label: Fix the copy
chips.consequence: R2 drops 'or coach' on closed_beta.rs and impressum.rs. The rights stay leader-only.

chips.label: Coaches may invite
chips.consequence: R2 widens require_leader for minting team invites to coaches, and adds a cross-tenant test.

questions.recommend: Fix the copy — it's the smaller change, and no team has asked for it yet.

questions.text: Login hint: the contract said “Forgot it? Ask your team admin.”, but a team leader cannot reset passwords; only the app admin can. Shipped: “Forgot it? Ask the Team Companion admin for a reset code.” Keep?

chips.label: Reword
chips.consequence: Send the text; it's one constant (FORGOT_PASSWORD_HINT in login.rs).

questions.recommend: Keep — it names the one person who can actually help.
